# Norxten Core

> Norxten Core is a B2B field cost control mobile app for general contractors.
> It provides OCR receipt and invoice scanning with project assignment, GPS
> crew punch-in/out with real-time labour visibility, and multi-project status
> tracking (on budget/over budget/on schedule/due soon).

Norxten Core is built by Norxten Technologies Inc., a Canadian company based
in Quebec. The app is available on iOS and Android with a 14-day free trial,
no credit card required.

## Product

- [Norxten Core](https://norxten.com/norxten-core.html): Product overview, 
  features, and pricing
- [Pricing](https://norxten.com/norxten-core.html#pricing): Starter ($49.99/mo),
  Field ($89.99/mo), Pro ($189.99/mo)
